style: Photorealistic modern enterprise AI and business objects, smoked glass, graphite, champagne metal, transparent background
concepts: A compact business growth sculpture: three ascending rectangular bars made of smoked optical glass and brushed champagne metal, with a slim ascending arrow arching across them; a small real silicon processor with fine copper circuit traces is embedded into the base. Instantly reads as AI-powered revenue growth.

A compact enterprise workflow sculpture: one central graphite AI processor connected by fine brushed copper pathways to four small smoked glass rounded-square nodes at different heights on a slim machined metal base. Clean coherent hub-and-spoke shape, instantly reads as intelligent workflow orchestration.

A compact profitability analytics sculpture: a thick smoked-glass donut chart with a single brushed champagne-metal segment lifted very slightly, the central opening reveals a small black silicon processor with visible gold contact pins. A low graphite base. Instantly reads as AI-powered business profitability.

A compact financial planning sculpture: a single upright smoked-glass display with a clear three-bar chart and a gently rising champagne-metal forecast line physically embedded in the glass, mounted on a low graphite base with fine copper circuit traces. No numbers, no labels. Instantly reads as AI financial forecasting.

A compact business intelligence sculpture: a clear optical-glass cube with a small intricate neural network of metallic nodes and champagne-metal connections suspended inside, floating directly above a small black silicon processor on a low graphite platform. Instantly reads as extracting intelligence and value from data.

A compact enterprise AI infrastructure sculpture: three slim dark graphite server modules stacked neatly with tiny warm white indicator lights, a small black processor with gold contacts seated prominently at the front, thin copper connections visibly linking the modules. Instantly reads as secure enterprise AI infrastructure.
